race.comment: Wide open. TANGO JEWEL (4) is fitter for two runs back and looks well placed here back slightly in grade. Won only start here and has a great record when third-up. Could be over the odds and looks a top chance to find form in an open race. HELL'S DIAMOND (12) is a promising type off the mark here on debut back in March. Returned in similar grade at Wodonga and ran well but found one better. Has more upside than most and looks likely to feature again. BAJARIA (13) was solid fresh at Geelong finishing fourth but less than a length from the winner. Fitter and sure to measure up here. SWIFT CIRCLE (11) wasn't beaten far last time and rates well on best figures.
